description.en: Central income support paid by direct bank transfer to eligible landholding farmer families identified by States and Union Territories.

benefit_summary.en: An eligible landholding farmer family receives Rs 6,000 per year as three instalments of Rs 2,000, transferred directly to its Aadhaar-seeded bank account. This is income support, not a repayable loan. A family means husband, wife, and minor children; this is a family benefit, not Rs 6,000 separately for each member.

eligibility_summary.en: Cultivable landholding farmer families are considered irrespective of holding size, subject to State or UT verification and exclusions. Excluded categories include institutional landholders; families with current/former constitutional or specified elected office holders; specified serving or retired government, public-sector, autonomous-body, or regular local-body employees; pensioners receiving Rs 10,000 or more monthly; last-assessment-year income-tax payers; and registered practising doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants, or architects. MTS/Class IV/Group D exceptions apply to the employee and pensioner exclusions. eKYC is mandatory. The portal flags post-1-February-2019 land acquisition and duplicate-family benefit cases for physical verification; a registration is not approval.

notes.en: Do not share Aadhaar numbers or OTPs with the voice agent. Biometric eKYC is available through CSCs and authorised channels.

name.en: Bank account details for direct benefit transfer
Cultivable landholding records required for State verification

notes.en: The State or Union Territory checks the recorded holding and exclusions before approval.

instruction.en: Use New Farmer Registration on the official PM-KISAN portal or an authorised local channel.

Complete mandatory eKYC through the portal or an authorised CSC; ensure Aadhaar, Aadhaar-seeded bank account, and cultivable land details agree. The bank or authorised centre can help correct seeding issues; never give an OTP to the voice agent.

Use Know Your Status on the official PM-KISAN portal to inspect verification or payment status. For withheld or rejected cases, approach the designated State/UT nodal officer or revenue office with the stated issue; submitting an application does not guarantee payment.
